summary: Rebuilt the record's measuring guards and the verified-job rule. L25: a pitch is rise per 12 or degrees ("30 deg" was refused and is now 6.93/12, x1.155); nothing steeper than 24/12 is taken; a bare 100 (was 10,072 sq ft on a 1,200 sq ft footprint) is refused with a hint, and a bare 30 (30/12) is refused and offers 30°. L26: a measurement that breaks takes back the square feet it gave: walls 120 ft x 8 ft, 960 sq ft, Ready, Good $1,500 / Better $2,575 / Best $5,270 -> height cleared: 0 sq ft, Incomplete, not priced, with a "Finish measuring" button; lib/field/measuring.ts measurementChecks() gives each such area a Fix whose target (lib/field/fix.ts FixTarget) a Send checklist can use. L27: a self-crossing outline is an error with a plain message, not an area with a note. L28: satellite parts with no roof data (carports) start switched off whenever the switch is offered: 9 Carport Ct attic floor 2,230 -> 1,990 sq ft. L29: a low slope never reads 2/12 (rise 1.96: "2/12 (low slope)" -> "1.9/12 (low slope)"). L37: a job with verified actuals offers no status changes ("Mark in progress" and "Cancel job" -> none); the owner can Unverify. No price formula changed; the random-quote counts are the same as after the cavity stage.

notDone: No Send checklist yet: measurementChecks() and FixTarget are ready for it, but sendChecks.ts and the SendStep Fix buttons belong to the quotes/send stage. Today the area card shows the problem and its Finish measuring button.
RF-06 rest (record follow-up): a finished measurement still sets the area's square feet as it changes; applying it only when Use is pressed is not done.
An unfinished measurement on an area whose size was typed by hand leaves that size priced (it was never the measurement's). The card says "not finished"; measurementChecks() does not list it.
The 24/12 limit is in the app only: the database does not check pitches (they live inside the estimate document). A pitch from a photo over 24/12 is written into the field and then refused there.
A bare number from 12 to 24 is still read as rise per 12 (a real, steep roof). It now carries a note with its angle and how to type degrees, not an error.

L37 is in the screens only: crew_set_job_status() in the database still accepts completed -> in_progress or cancelled for staff on a verified job. Blocking it there needs a migration, which this stage was told to leave alone.
Faces saved from earlier lookups keep the choice they were saved with; only new lookups start with the parts with no roof data off.
The record's L28 example (1,960 sq ft for "3 Carport Ct") and L25 factor (x1.157) were not reproduced: the record's house is not in it, and 1/cos 30° is 1.155. Both are explained in the ledger.
notesForNextStage: API: see apiNotes.
